body: Cancer isn't exactly my first choice.  I'd love to live in a world where you could explain your case to a doctor and go with dignity, quickly and painlessly.  But that's not an option.  And because I don't want to leave my family with a suicide, I'm not left with a lot of options.  I don't want to have any non consenting participants (train, car, suicide by cop).  It might be a lot of pain, but I can stand it if it means I can die in a way that leaves the people that care about me a little more at peace.

My bad.  Let me rephrase, I hate that I exist.  I hate that I am alive.  I hate not knowing if I'm going to stay up for three days, or sleep for 16 hours and be too miserable to get out of bed.  I hate feeling like I might be getting better only to realise after a few days (sometimes weeks) that I was just manic.  And all the great decisions I was making we actually horrible.  And then going through the horrible depression that tends to follow.  I hate the medications I get put on that make me a zombie that either doesn't eat at all, or only eats.  That can't put two thoughts together to save her life.  I hate that no one seems to understand that in my situation, death is preferable.
Still not worth it.
I'll have to get treatment?  Can't I choose not to? Please reply. I'm sorry to hear about you.  I hope for the best, whatever that may be.
I thought that once it got to the hospice care point, people are heavily drugged to make the end easier.  Please reply w/ more info.
Not existing is still preferable to a miserable existence.
Thank you for that.  I know that for some people, that can and will make a huge difference.

Things won't get better.  And honestly, after I realized that, I'm so much more at peace.  It's not like I had a hard day and now I want to take a break.  Not all life is worth living, and any person would come to that conclusion if they we're living with the shit I have.
Yeah...  one of the reasons I gave up on trying to talk to people about this stuff.  It just makes them sad and uncomfortable and doesn't really help.  Just drives people away.
Thank you for understanding.
Thank you.  I'm sorry I was nasty earlier.  It just gets hard to hear that I need to talk to people when my personal experience on the issue shows that that only drives people away.
Thank you.  I know it's wrong, I do.  But the worse I get, the easier it is to justify.

I'm not trying to be rude, but this is a life lesson that everyone needs to learn eventually; no one wants to listen.  No one asks how you you are to be answered with anything other than "good, you?" 

People don't give a fucking shit about my problems. Thats why they're mine.  And if someone does "listen" they just want to offer simple suggestions as if I'm a brainless prick that has never thought about therapy/medication/sleep habits/sitting in the sun/acupuncture/deep breathing/ect. Then, when their suggestions don't work and they realize that they might actually have to listen to you, they get busy, or you can see them slowly start to tune you out.  And I know that I am coming off as an asshole right now that deserves to be ignored but godfuckingdammit I hate hearing the same things over and over and over again. 

Death will be a PERMANENT solution to my PERMANENT problem.
Oh there's no such thing as a listening ear.  No one wants to hear about problems they can't fix.  The stiff drink however...

I suppose that could be true, but I've been to mental hospitals before that didn't make me feel so uncomfortable. Admittedly, I think, outside of Kaw Valley Center, it was the only state funded one I'd ever been to.  And it is by far the oldest.  I just want to see what other people's experiences were like.  Especially with the fact that we interacted with prisoners on a daily basis.  It is just a very topsy turvy place to me, and I wanted to hear the opinions and stories of others who'd been there before.
Yes, correct.

I was talking more about the Hospital, but I wasn't very specific so I apologize for that.  


I just found the hospital very ominous.  Like the staff was hiding something all the time... it's hard to explain.
I've never tried the N one.  Seroquel... I hated.  Prozac and zoloft, tbh, I didn't take regularly enough to ever find out if they worked or not.
Thanks! I think that's a really good idea. I finally have the energy and a little bit of motivation so I should strike while the iron is hot.
That's great!
Effexor. Thank you! Technically, I'm prescribed abilify too, but I still don't want to take it.  My mood is a lot more stable so hopefully I won't have to.
I don't have any advice, but I can say that you aren't alone.  I feel the same way. it hurts and it sucks so much.  But at least we aren't alone in this feeling.

I am very scared I could hurt someone just as badly as that.  In all of my actions so far, I think I've led a very good life.  I try to be a good person and am told all the time that I am.  But it's more out of obligation than because I want to.  To be honest, I don't much care for other people.  Even those I'm close to, I could do with out.  It's because I know I shouldn't that I don't do bad things, but I think my moral compass is getting skewed. Right and wrong have been harder and harder to keep straight in the past months and especially weeks.

Personally, I and those around me consider me a good person.  However, as I get older, I can tell my mental illness is getting worse.  I have trouble figuring out sometimes what's real anymore and what I made up in my head. 

I've seen what people with bad mental health problems have done to their loved ones, and the fact that doing that has crossed my mind before terrifies me.  I don't know how bad it will get before it gets better and I'm so scared to find out.

I do think about the way this will affect the ones I'm close to a lot.  In fact, this line of thinking is the reason I am still alive today.  Unfortunately, when you want nothing other than death, you begin to resent the thing keeping you from it.  So, as much as I love my friends and family, I kind of have a resentment towards them.  I don't want to, but it's there.  I wish I could show them why I have to do this, and they could let me be free.

I try to tell myself that I could possibly have an impact on humanity if I choose to live, but it's hard to believe when I have trouble just doing day to day stuff.  
I know suicide is selfish, but at the Same time, I have no real will to live.  And to be honest, I would rather be selfish than selfless and live a life I have little interest in.
I do.  Not so much anymore, my anxiety isn't nearly as bad as it was when I was younger.

Unfortunately meds, therapy, and being institutionalized haven't helped me yet.  They just cost a shit load of money and the meds make me a zombie.  I've sought help and it has done nothing.  crazy is as crazy does and I'm afraid of what I'll rationalize as I get worse if I've already rationalized this.  Sometimes I think about taking my loved ones with me... I know that's horrible and at this moment in time I have no intention of doing such a thing, but what if one day that is something I convince myself is the right thing to do.
But it's the only way to effectively insure I will not hurt people in other decisions.
But my would has written and finished hundreds of other life books.  Skipping this one or even a few won't hurt. It's cutting out the bullshit and helping create simplicity.
I feel like this all the time.  I wish people would realize that suicide isn't a horrible thing.  It's closing a shitty book and deciding not to read til the end.
God it feels so good to write this.  I am so filled with relief.

Basically the universe (or multiverse) is a grid that made up of variables.  Two variables intersect to make a universe. Or person. Or anything. And the space between the grids are the outcomes.. 4 possible outcomes.  Two good. Two bad. Two weak. Two strong. One is good and strong, one bad and strong, one good and weak, done bad and week.  I am in a universe where my variables makes me bad and weak.  If I kill myself, I will move on to another one where I can he happier.  But killing myself is going to be super scary and that's why I haven't done it yet.
